model_annotation: This is a bar chart comparing the contribution to domestic demand of various countries or regions, measured as percentages of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) with 2011 as the base year. The vertical axis lists countries in a non-english language, while the horizontal axis represents the percentage of GDP contribution. Each bar is color-coded, with dark blue indicating the proportion of reference value, light blue showing the reference year of 2021, and green representing the contribution in 2024. The bars are arranged in descending order of GDP contribution. The chart also includes a few numerical values at the bottom to indicate the relative difference in reference value (1.5%), reference year (2021), and the contribution year (2024).
